sampling_rule: Hard-negative shortfall recorded as STRATUM_UNAVAILABLE. Main strata proportions NOT redistributed. No silent substitution.

adjudication_questions.A: Is there a real mechanistic relationship? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)
adjudication_questions.C: Is there a plausible transferable mechanism? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)
adjudication_questions.D1: Is the specific relationship explicitly established in literature? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)
adjudication_questions.E: Can the pair generate a non-trivial discovery question? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)
adjudication_questions.F: Is it sufficiently difficult that a competent scientist cannot trivially answer? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)
adjudication_questions.G: Does it create a legitimate discovery opportunity? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)
adjudication_questions.H: Could a competent scientist be fooled into believing these mechanisms transfer when they actually do not? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)
adjudication_questions.I: Can this pair support a specific, falsifiable scientific prediction whose outcome could distinguish a genuine transfer from a superficial analogy? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)

task_type_rules.W_TASK: A=YES, B=YES, C=YES, E=YES, F=YES, G=YES, I=YES, D3=ESTABLISHED
task_type_rules.S_CANDIDATE: A=YES, B=YES, C=YES, E=YES, F=YES, G=YES, I=YES, D1=NO, D2=ADEQUATE, D3=NOT_ESTABLISHED
task_type_rules.REJECT: Does not meet W or S criteria, or I!=YES

rules: Custodian must NOT see heuristic scores, strata, or dispositions before adjudicating.
I=YES is REQUIRED for benchmark candidacy.
D1=NO alone does NOT establish S-TASK.
If abstract status is not ABSTRACT_PRESENT, note in rationale.
No TEE access. No benchmark construction. No taxonomy changes.
